summary: The retrieved content defines a .NET class for managing Clinical Practice Codes within the HSPnet system. It details the structure and behavior of the class, including properties, methods for adding, updating, deleting, and searching Clinical Practice Codes, and interactions with a database using SQL commands.
purpose: To provide programmatic management and database operations for Clinical Practice Codes in a healthcare or educational application setting, using C# within the HSPnet framework.

workflows.name: Add Clinical Practice Code
steps: Validate input fields (Name and ShortName must not be blank).
If valid, set database procedure to 'ClinicalPracticeCodeAdd'.
Add parameters (ProgramID, Name, ShortName) to the database call.

steps: Check if ID is not zero and input fields are valid.
Add parameters (ID, Name, ShortName) to the database call.

steps: Add parameter (ID) to the database call.

steps: Add parameter (ID) to the database call.

steps: Add necessary parameters (ProgramID, ShowInactive, keyword for programs or StudentID for students) to the database call.
